notes: One September 2016 maintenance manual covers both the M800 and the M900. Its feature list applies to various models, so check the machine type label on the side of the case before counting on a part.

gaps: The manual's pages do not name the chassis (the file name says SFF); its stated dimensions are width 93 mm, height 343 mm, depth 364 mm, and they are not matched to a chassis name here.
The manual gives FRU descriptions but no FRU part numbers; it points to Lenovo's service parts lookup, which was not read.
No output voltage or rails are given for the power supply, so no voltage is set.
The storage drive is called a 'storage drive' without saying hard disk or solid state, so no hard drive, spindle motor or magnet claim is made (dropped).
The coin cell is named only by Lenovo part number 45C1566, from a general safety notice in chapter 1 rather than the replacement section; no CR-type or size is given.
The optical drive and the rear fan connector are shown or named without a type or rating, so neither is claimed as a part.
method: Lenovo ThinkCentre M800 and M900 Hardware Maintenance Manual, third edition September 2016, machine types 10FG, 10FH, 10FX, 10FY (download.lenovo.com PDF, read as text).

Read: the computer components and major FRUs and CRUs tables, parts on the system board, the Features and Specifications sections, the chapter 1 lithium battery notice, and the coin-cell, power supply, speaker, front fan and heat sink replacement sections.

comps.spec: 210 W automatic voltage-sensing power supply (manual's feature list); the computer's stated electrical input is 100-240 V AC, 50/60 Hz. Power supply assembly is an optional-service CRU held by three screws and a retaining clip; the manual says never to remove the cover of a power supply.
Heat sink and fan assembly for the microprocessor (optional-service CRU), four screws to the system board, cable to the microprocessor fan connector; a heat sink fan duct snaps on top
Front fan (FRU), attached to the chassis by four rubber mounts; cable to the front fan connector on the system board
Internal speaker (FRU), held by four metal clips on the inner side of the front panel; cable to the internal speaker connector on the system board

Coin-cell battery on the system board (self-service CRU) that keeps the date, time and settings; the manual's lithium battery notice gives Lenovo part number 45C1566 or an equivalent type the manufacturer recommends
System board power connectors: one 10-pin power connector and one 4-pin power connector, plus two SATA power connectors for an optical drive or a storage drive

sources.title: Lenovo ThinkCentre M800 and M900 Hardware Maintenance Manual (third edition, September 2016; machine types 10FG, 10FH, 10FX, 10FY)
